title: Sekirei amateur-analysis benchmark record (v1)
description:
One engine's analysis of one position, produced by scripts/usi_analysis_export.py. See docs/amateur_analysis_benchmark.md for the format's purpose and metric definitions. This schema is documentation only -- no jsonschema validator is wired into this repo's tooling, so conformance is not enforced at export time.

Design notes:
- `settings.depth`/`settings.nodes` and `lines[].score_cp`/`lines[].score_mate` are mutually exclusive via `oneOf` on KEY PRESENCE, not value nullability: a producer MUST OMIT the unused key entirely. Setting it to `null` still satisfies `required` and would fail `oneOf` by satisfying both branches.
- `engine.weight_sha256` is the deliberate exception to that omission convention: it is always present, explicitly `null` when no weight file was loaded (material-eval fallback -- the expected default today, see docs/nnue_weights.md), and a hex string when one was.
- `lines[].bound` absent means the engine emitted no bound token at all -- NOT that the score is exact. Every line Sekirei currently emits omits this token.
- `lines[].bestmove` mirrors `lines[].pv[0]` for that candidate line ("what this rank recommends"), distinct from the top-level `bestmove`/`ponder` pair, which is the engine's one actual final USI `bestmove` command.

game_id.description: Held-out split unit -- see docs/amateur_analysis_benchmark.md's game-level splitting section.

bestmove.description: The engine's actual final USI bestmove token. null when status != "ok".

ponder.description: Optional key, present only when the engine sent a ponder move; omitted (not null) otherwise.

error_detail.description: null when status == "ok"; a human-readable cause otherwise.

wall_time_ms.description: Driver-measured elapsed time (process spawn + handshake + search), distinct from lines[].time_ms which is the engine's own self-reported search-only time.

build_info.description: Sekirei's `--build-info` JSON when available (name, version, nnue_arch, weight_magic, weight_size_expected, king_relative_b_small, spec_top_n_default); null for engines/builds without an equivalent.

weight_sha256.description: Explicit null means no weight file loaded (material-eval fallback), not "field not applicable".

lines.description: One entry per MultiPV rank at bestmove time (final snapshot, not a full search trace -- see docs/amateur_analysis_benchmark.md's eval-stability-across-depth methodology note). MUST be [] when status != "ok".

bound.description: Absent (not just omitted-as-"exact") means the engine emitted no bound token at all.

bestmove.description: Mirrors pv[0] for this candidate line.
